genius.headline: Stanford scientists revive bleached coral in the lab by placing it in contact with healthy fragments
genius.summary: Stanford researchers reported in Science Advances on Oct. 14 that bleached coral fragments fully recovered in the lab after brief contact with healthy, genetically identical fragments. According to Stanford, the corals fused tissue and the healthy fragments passed along beneficial algae within three days, and recovery took about seven weeks, the fastest documented to date.

quote.text: For the first time, scientists have observed bleached corals on the brink of death fully recover through brief contact with healthy clones.

facepalm.headline: Snohomish County, Wash., prints 'Genereal Election' on about 535,000 ballot return envelopes
facepalm.summary: Ballot return envelopes mailed to Snohomish County voters for the Nov. 3 general election were printed with the word 'General' spelled 'Genereal'. Residents noticed it over the weekend before the county addressed it on Oct. 14. The Auditor's Office said staff proofread voter names, ID numbers and barcodes but missed the misspelling; Auditor Garth Fell said the ballots remain valid.

quote.text: The word “General” was printed as “Genereal” on about 535,000 envelopes mailed earlier this month for the Nov. 3 election.
